lines.text: You can't just walk in and buy a Birkin.
A Birkin twenty-five, in Togo leather. Straight from the boutique.
The US sticker price: thirteen and a half grand.
First, buyers say, you build a purchase history. Scarves, shoes, home goods.
Collectors describe spending one to one. Some say double.
A twenty twenty-four lawsuit alleged illegal tying. Dismissed, now on appeal.
At one to one, your thirteen-grand bag really costs twenty-seven thousand.
Or skip the line: resale runs close to thirty grand. Which would you pay?
